title: Axiom of choice
summary: A simultaneous choice can be made from every member of a family of nonempty sets.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared classical first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: A simultaneous choice can be made from every member of a family of nonempty sets.
content.exact: One formulation: every set A of nonempty sets has a function f with domain A such that f(x)∈x for every x∈A.
content.example: For a finite family, choices can be made without the full axiom; the axiom governs arbitrary families.
content.caveat: Choice has many equivalent forms in ZF and consequences that may be nonconstructive; weaker and stronger variants must be named.
